output.summary: Most of Arts' resolution gap comes from SlotBook tickets routed to the P4 best-effort queue (RR-17), which removes about 70% of the gap. Arts non-SlotBook tickets match other faculties in remotely handled queues, so the Dean's claim of faculty-level deprioritisation is not supported. Arts' volume is mostly SlotBook, not trivial or duplicate tickets. The remaining gap tracks Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site coverage at Lindqvist, which Education shares. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unresolved, since only the ITS Director's account exists. The SSO-driven rise in SlotBook tickets looks like a category artifact. Disclosing the P4 timeframe and agreeing SlotBook's support status is the preferred, low-risk next step. Blanket P4 routing is harmful, and CampusBook migration and the 2 FTE transfer are premature.
